svg.title: Figure 11.5 — Swarm Nest-Site Communication
svg.desc: Scout discovery, competing dances, evidence accumulation, quorum and swarm departure shown as a distributed group decision process.
svg.text: Nest-site choice emerges from scout competition and recruitment, not command by the queen.
enough scouts gather at one site
The queen does not select the new cavity. Scout-worker recruitment and quorum dynamics are central to nest-site decision-making.
